source_title: Namo Narayana’s untold story: Lesser-known facts about Rajinikanth’s co-star
source_excerpt: Not every actor needs a lead role to leave a lasting impression. He even had a 10-year visa for the United States before deciding to explore his interest in movies.Having been born in Madurai, Namo Narayana had no significant contacts in the film world when he entered it. He later developed a close association with Sasikumar and continued working in films directed by him and Samuthirakani.Over the years, Namo Narayana has made a steady mark in films with supporting, comedic, and character performances in both urban and rural dramas where he played politicians.
